scope: Only the 23 currently claimed B044h/B046h goals; all 22 bound current images opened individually through view_image. No canonical, central registry, ledger, historical review or human approval changed.
rules: KEEP corrected/current good assets, including existing JPGs; new corrected candidates must be PNG.
Friendly, abstract, clear, comic-like style; no photorealistic or sterile-technical redesign.
Independent current candidate review required before import or gate completion; this visual audit does not itself supply D/P/A/M closure.
Non-image source holds are explicitly unverified here; current description/prerequisite issues are backed by current canonical fields.

records.title: Matrixpotenzen für langfristige Übergangsprozesse nutzen (LK)
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Potenzen von Übergangsmatrizen nutzen, um langfristige Entwicklungen von Übergangsprozessen zu untersuchen und Zwischenergebnisse im Kontext zu deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can use powers of transition matrices to analyze long-term developments of transition processes and interpret intermediate results in context.
checks: Current resourceLinks bind no goal-visualization image. No image defect or need for a new image is inferred from the source-scope hold.
nonImage: Historical B046 round B identifies HE-GK visibility contrary to HE-KC p.43 LK scope. Current description still explicitly addresses long-term transition matrix powers (LK). Current applicability and primary source must be checked separately; not verified by this visual audit.
records.action: Targeted HE applicability/source review; preserve description unless it yields a concrete mismatch.

records.title: Grenzprozesse und Grenzmatrizen interpretieren (LK)
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Grenzprozesse bei Potenzen von Übergangsmatrizen untersuchen, Grenzmatrizen interpretieren und ihre Bedeutung für stabile Langzeitentwicklungen erläutern.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can analyze limiting processes of powers of transition matrices, interpret limiting matrices, and explain their meaning for stable long-term developments.
checks: M=[[0.8,0.3],[0.2,0.7]] is column-stochastic; stationary vector (0.6,0.4) and limiting matrix with equal columns are arithmetically consistent.
defects: Stationary vector g is already drawn vertically but also has superscript T, making M·g dimensionally invalid.
nonImage: Historical HE-GK/LK scope hold (HE-KC p.43) still needs current applicability/source verification.
records.action: Targeted reference-image edit: remove T only from the already vertical g; retain T on horizontal row notation.

records.title: Geometrische Abbildungen als linear erkennen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann bei einer einfachen geometrischen Abbildung anhand der Verträglichkeit mit Vektoraddition und skalarer Multiplikation prüfen, ob sie linear ist.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can determine whether a simple geometric mapping is linear by checking whether it preserves vector addition and scalar multiplication.
checks: Actual current PNG inspected: T(x,y)=(2x,y), additivity example (1,0)+(0,1) and homogeneity with u=(1,1), lambda=2 all correct.
All-quantifier and warning that T(0)=0 alone is insufficient are explicitly shown. Current plot directions and numerical labels match.
nonImage: Current direct requires still includes Hauptsatz der Differential- und Integralrechnung and Ableitungen elementarer Funktionen; these are unrelated mandatory prerequisites for this elementary linearity competence.
records.action: Keep current image bytes; correct the evidenced prerequisite barrier in a separate reviewed graph change.

records.title: Geometrische Abbildungen mit Matrizen beschreiben
records.description: Die lernende Person kann geometrische Abbildungen, etwa Schattenwürfe oder Projektionen, mithilfe von Matrizen beschreiben und die Matrixwirkung fachsprachlich deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can describe geometric mappings, such as shadows or projections, using matrices and explain the matrix action precisely.
defects: Q=(-1,2) is drawn on the y-axis.
P prime=(5,0) appears twice, including an upper point away from the x-axis.
records.action: Rebuild a single unambiguous plot using the same mapping and numbers.

records.title: Bildpunkte mit Matrizen berechnen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann zu einer gegebenen Abbildungsmatrix Bildpunkte berechnen, indem sie Vektoren mit der Matrix multipliziert.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can calculate image points for a given mapping matrix by multiplying vectors with the matrix.
checks: A=[[1,1],[0,1]] sends P=(2,1), Q=(0,2), R=(-1,1) to (3,1), (2,2), (0,1); all printed products and plotted point coordinates correct.
defects: Orange correspondence arrow starts next to P but ends at R prime. Green Q correspondence has no identifiable Q origin.
records.action: Targeted edit of correspondence arrows; preserve correct grids, values, formulas and style.

records.title: Orthogonale Spiegelungen an Koordinatenebenen mit Matrizen darstellen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Abbildungsmatrizen für orthogonale Spiegelungen an den Koordinatenebenen bestimmen, untersuchen und Bildpunkte berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can determine and analyze mapping matrices for orthogonal reflections in coordinate planes and calculate image points.
checks: Sxy=diag(1,1,-1), P=(2,1,3)→(2,1,-3) correct; z sign changes while x/y stay fixed.
defects: Midpoint / foot of the vertical reflection segment lies directly on displayed y-axis although x=2.
records.action: Correct common footpoint in the xy-plane; label F=(2,1,0) and use a consistent oblique projection.

records.title: Parallelprojektionen auf Koordinatenebenen mit Matrizen darstellen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Abbildungsmatrizen für Parallelprojektionen auf die Koordinatenebenen bestimmen, untersuchen und Bildpunkte berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can determine and analyze mapping matrices for parallel projections onto coordinate planes and calculate image points.
checks: Three diagonal matrices and result triples for P=(2,-1,3) are correct orthogonal special cases of parallel projection.
defects: Original point has apparent positive-y location despite y=-1.
yz projection arrow drawn horizontally parallel to y instead of parallel to removed x direction.
records.action: Correct spatial diagrams and explicitly label illustrated cases as projections parallel to coordinate axes; retain broader goal scope.

records.title: Zentrische Streckungen am Koordinatenursprung mit Matrizen darstellen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Abbildungsmatrizen zentrischer Streckungen am Koordinatenursprung bestimmen, untersuchen und die Wirkung auf Bildpunkte berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can determine and analyze mapping matrices for central dilations at the coordinate origin and calculate their effect on image points.
checks: Z=2I; P=(1,2)→(2,4), Q=(-2,1)→(-4,2), common origin lines, fixed origin all match plotted grid.
defects: Four displayed column vectors in Z products have extra superscript T; dimensionally invalid matrix-by-row product.
records.action: Minimal reference-image edit: remove only four T superscripts on already vertical vectors.

records.title: Eigene Abbildungen modellieren und interpretieren
records.description: Die lernende Person kann zu gegebenen geometrischen Anforderungen (z. B. Spiegelung an einer schrägen Geraden, Streckung in einer beliebigen Richtung) passende Abbildungsmatrizen konstruieren, testen und im Kontext begründen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can construct, test, and justify appropriate mapping matrices for given geometric requirements (e.g., reflection on an oblique line, stretching in any direction).
checks: Reflection matrix [[0,1],[1,0]], y=x line, P(3,1)→(1,3), Q(-2,4)→(4,-2), fixed R(2,2) all consistent on current image.
nonImage: Current DE/EN description still permits reflection in an arbitrary oblique line, although ordinary linear matrices require an origin line. Specify linear maps and oblique origin lines, not a new homogeneous-coordinate scope.
records.action: Keep current image; narrow DE/EN wording to the intended linear scope and review affected context bindings.

records.title: Drehungen um Koordinatenachsen mit Matrizen darstellen (LK)
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Abbildungsmatrizen für Drehungen um die Koordinatenachsen im $\mathbb{R}^3$ untersuchen und bestimmen sowie Bildpunkte berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can analyze and determine mapping matrices for rotations around the coordinate axes in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and calculate image points.
defects: Main coordinate picture labels two different axes y.
Basis picture labels two different red directions as -e_x and downward blue direction as e_z although positive e_z points up.
nonImage: Historical HE-GK versus LK scope hold (HE-KC p.44) requires current source/applicability verification.
records.action: Replace flawed coordinate/basis pictures with a clear xy top-view of positive 90° rotation and explicit invariant z.

records.title: Ereignisse darstellen und Baumdiagramme nutzen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann mehrstufige Zufallsexperimente in Baumdiagrammen darstellen, Pfadregeln anwenden und Wahrscheinlichkeiten an konkreten Beispielrechnungen berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can represent multi-stage random experiments with tree diagrams, apply path rules, and compute probabilities using concrete worked examples.
checks: Two-stage fair coin tree has four outcomes KK/KZ/ZK/ZZ; all conditional branches 1/2, path product 1/4, exactly one K =1/2.
Highlighting and arrows group disjoint KZ/ZK correctly; standard contextual notation is readable.
nonImage: Current EN says 'using concrete worked examples' while competence should mean independent calculation, not dependence on supplied solutions; DE also unnecessarily says 'an konkreten Beispielrechnungen berechnen'.
records.action: Keep current image; clarify equivalent DE/EN independent path-rule competence.

records.title: Vierfeldertafeln interpretieren
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Vier- bzw. Mehrfeldertafeln aus Sachtexten erstellen, absolute und relative Häufigkeiten eintragen und gemeinsame sowie bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeiten an konkreten Beispielen ablesen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can build four- or multi-field tables from contextual data, enter absolute and relative frequencies, and read joint as well as conditional probabilities in concrete examples.
checks: Count table 30/20/10/40 sums to 100; relative table and three quotient calculations .30,.60,.75 are correct.
defects: Arrow labelled conditional P(A|B) points to joint cell .30; P(B|A) arrow points only to marginal .40, misleading about what is read directly.
records.action: Retain tables and quotient results; replace ambiguous one-cell conditional arrows with numerator/denominator grouping.

records.title: Bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeiten berechnen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann bedingte Wahrscheinlichkeiten in Sachzusammenhängen identifizieren und sie mit Baumdiagrammen sowie Vier- oder Mehrfeldertafeln aus absoluten oder relativen Häufigkeiten berechnen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can identify conditional probabilities in context and compute them with tree diagrams and four- or multi-field tables from absolute or relative frequencies.
checks: Current table .30/.20/.10/.40, margins .40/.60 and .50/.50 all consistent.
P(B|A)=.30/.40=.75 and complement .25; remaining branch labels .33/.67 are conventional two-decimal renderings of 1/3 and 2/3, consistent with terminal .20/.40 to rounding.
nonImage: No new substantive goal-text issue found in targeted inspection. Existing missing D/P closure is not supplied by this visual KEEP.
records.action: Preserve asset; resolve historical held binding/round disagreement without new cosmetic generation.

records.title: Vektoren als Orts-, Richtungs- und Verschiebungsvektoren im Raum beschreiben
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Vektoren im Raum als Verschiebungs-, Orts- oder Richtungsvektoren darstellen, ihre Komponenten in kartesischen Koordinatensystemen angeben und ihre geometrische Bedeutung fachsprachlich deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can represent vectors in space as displacement, position, or direction vectors, state their components in Cartesian coordinate systems, and interpret their geometric meaning using correct terminology.
checks: AB=B-A=(3,1,2) arithmetic correct for A=(1,2,1), B=(4,3,3).
Distinction between origin position and point-to-point displacement is otherwise appropriate.
defects: Direction-vector card falsely says direction vector gives length/scaling of a line.
A/B positions cannot share positive linear x/y axis scales with displayed x down-left, y right, z up: horizontal displacements approximately 150 and 680 imply a negative y scale.
records.action: Correct direction wording and replace spatial example with consistently projected coordinates.

records.title: Räumliche Objekte im Koordinatensystem verorten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann räumliche Objekte im dreidimensionalen Koordinatensystem verorten und geeignete Koordinatenbezüge wählen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can locate spatial objects in a three-dimensional coordinate system and choose suitable coordinate references.
checks: All eight cuboid corner triples describe a valid 4×3×2 cuboid.
defects: Front horizontal BC edge is labelled x=4 but must be y=3 for the printed corner triples.
Slanted CD edge labelled y=3 must be x=4. Unexplained dashed mid/top construction adds ambiguity.
records.action: Correct axis-aligned length labels and remove unexplained interior construction; preserve simple friendly cuboid visual.

records.title: Einfache geometrische Figuren beschreiben
records.description: Die lernende Person kann einfache geometrische Figuren, insbesondere gleichschenklige, gleichseitige und rechtwinklige Dreiecke sowie Quadrat, Rechteck, Raute, Parallelogramm, Trapez und Drachenviereck, fachsprachlich beschreiben.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can describe simple plane figures, especially isosceles, equilateral, and right triangles as well as squares, rectangles, rhombi, parallelograms, trapezia, and kites, using correct terminology.
checks: Current rhombus has four equal-side ticks and no false identical-angle markers.
Current kite has single ticks on its upper adjacent pair and double ticks on its lower pair.
Square/rectangle right angles, triangle types, opposite parallel families and inclusive trapezoid text consistent. Duplicate isosceles example is harmless, not a reason to regenerate.
nonImage: Historical round-B cited image defects are absent in the actual current bytes. Targeted current review/binding resolution is needed, not new generation.
records.action: KEEP current corrected asset, with exact current hash; resolve old hold through independent current check.

records.title: Geometriesoftware zur Raumorientierung nutzen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Geometriesoftware nutzen, um räumliche Objekte im dreidimensionalen Koordinatensystem darzustellen, Ansichten zu variieren und Koordinaten- bzw. Lageinformationen zu überprüfen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can use geometry software to represent spatial objects in a three-dimensional coordinate system, vary views, and check coordinate or positional information.
checks: Top view Pxy(2,1) and height z=3 are correct for P(2,1,3).
defects: Main x-axis projection of Pxy(2,1,0) lands at label 1 rather than 2.
Side-view horizontal axis is unidentified.
records.action: Correct x tick to 2, name side projection yz or xz consistently; preserve software/rotatable-view concept.

records.title: Vektoren im Raum addieren und vervielfachen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Vektoren im Raum komponentenweise addieren und mit Skalaren vervielfachen sowie die Rechenoperationen als Verkettung und Streckung von Verschiebungen geometrisch deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can add vectors in space component-wise, multiply them by scalars, and interpret the operations geometrically as chained and scaled displacements.
checks: Printed a+b=(1,3,4) and 2a=(4,2,2) are numerically correct.
defects: a and 2a arrows from same origin visibly differ in direction, violating scalar multiplication.
b=(-1,2,3) points left despite both -x and +y contributing right under displayed axes.
records.action: Generate two clean panels with correct head-to-tail addition and strictly collinear doubling.

records.title: Linearkombinationen von Vektoren bilden und deuten
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Vektoren als Linearkombination gegebener Vektoren darstellen, passende Koeffizienten bestimmen und die Darstellung geometrisch deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can represent vectors as linear combinations of given vectors, determine suitable coefficients, and interpret the representation geometrically.
defects: u=(1,0,1) points right even though positive x points left and z is vertical; y=0 cannot provide a rightward component.
records.action: Correct coordinate projection and consistent plane/head-to-tail example; keep linear-combination scope.

records.title: Lineare Abhängigkeit und Unabhängigkeit von Vektoren prüfen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann entscheiden, ob Vektoren linear abhängig oder unabhängig sind, die Entscheidung rechnerisch begründen und die geometrische Bedeutung erläutern.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can decide whether vectors are linearly dependent or independent, justify the decision algebraically, and explain the geometric meaning.
checks: a=(1,0,0),b=(0,1,0),c=(1,1,0), a+b-c=0 and standard-basis independence correct.
defects: Dependent-case a points along a rightward direction incompatible with x down-left under the displayed coordinate convention; b and c do not provide a consistent basis sum picture.
records.action: Rebuild dependent and independent geometric examples with one explicitly labelled coordinate convention and common arrow origin.

records.title: Kollinearität von Vektoren im Raum prüfen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann prüfen, ob zwei Vektoren im Raum kollinear sind, dazu skalare Vielfache oder Komponentenvergleiche nutzen und die Entscheidung geometrisch begründen.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can check whether two vectors in space are collinear, use scalar multiples or component comparisons, and justify the decision geometrically.
checks: b=2a and ratios 3/2,1,4/3 for noncollinear c are arithmetically correct.
defects: a=(2,-1,3) and c=(3,-1,4) drawn right though +x and -y both contribute left under shown axes.
records.action: Preserve two-example comparison; fix projection or use clearly labelled axis-free schematic arrows beside exact component tests.

records.title: Abstand zweier Punkte im Raum berechnen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann aus den Koordinaten zweier Punkte im Raum den Verbindungsvektor bilden, dessen Betrag berechnen und den Abstand geometrisch deuten.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can form the connecting vector from the coordinates of two points in space, calculate its magnitude, and interpret the distance geometrically.
records.provider: Google Gemini / Nano Banana Pro (user-provided candidate)
checks: B-A=(3,4,12), norm=sqrt(169)=13 correct.
defects: Screen positions of O,A(1,2,0),B(4,6,12) cannot share positive axis scales for displayed x down-left/y right/z up; B horizontal offset exceeds 4×A offset, forcing negative y scale.
nonImage: Existing human image approval is historical separate evidence; this audit must not erase it or convert it into current machine approval.
records.action: Use a consistent oblique projection, visible component path, and the existing 3-4-12-13 arithmetic.

records.title: Streckenlängen im Raum bestimmen
records.description: Die lernende Person kann Streckenlängen in räumlichen Figuren aus Punktkoordinaten oder geeigneten Verbindungsvektoren bestimmen und in geometrischen Kontexten verwenden.
records.descriptionEn: The learner can determine segment lengths in spatial figures from point coordinates or suitable connecting vectors and use them in geometric contexts.
checks: sqrt(6²+4²)=sqrt52 and sqrt(6²+4²+3²)=sqrt61 correct.
defects: Orange segment is called AC but ends at point labelled B.
Corner coordinates and displayed positive x/y directions disagree.
records.action: Correct cuboid axis/corner assignment and make orange AC and purple AG end at their labelled corners.
